summary: M0 model-only verdict: CONTAIN @ 0.88. Confirmed account takeover indicators: on 2026-10-13 the account authenticated five times from 192.0.2.200 (AS9009 M247 Europe, Bucharest, RO) on dev-tb-laptop, while the user's established pattern is İzmir/TR (198.51.100.120, Superonline) evenings and Manisa/TR (193.140.10.57, AS-AEGEAN-EDU) midday. Four of the five Bucharest authentications returned "success" with mfa_prompt_count=0 despite being from a new country/ASN/IP that would normally challenge MFA; one was mfa_approved. This is impossible travel concurrent with the user's normal İzmir evening window, and the absence of MFA challenge indicates session/token use or MFA bypass rather than legitimate travel. Normal İzmir activity resumes at 21:55:40. Mail events are empty, but the sign-in events themselves confirm unauthorized access, warranting containment (disable account, reset credentials, revoke sessions).
